analysis:
The PR generalizes MiMo-specific calibration into model-level calibration and adds a rate-observation helper. No concrete security regression found in the supplied hunks.

EngineV2Bridge+NativeLifecycle.swift: the only change is the rename at head line 86 (cancelMimoCalibration -> cancelModelCalibration). Native shutdown ordering is unchanged. The identity and receipt checks (lines 104-122), the pending-consumer guards (128-146), and the final owner release (150-155) are unchanged.

EngineV2Bridge+RateObservations.swift (new): holds numeric phase observations. During calibration they are buffered in modelCalibration.pendingObservations[requestID] (lines 19-20); otherwise they are applied immediately. Values are provider-local and feed the performance and deadline evidence. This is self-reported provider state and does not touch prompt content or the encryption path. Next-pass check: confirm pendingObservations is cleared when a calibration cell is cancelled or fails, to avoid unbounded growth. This is an availability nit, not a confirmed issue.

EngineV2Bridge+Submission.swift: adds measurementPurpose (default .serving) and passes calibrationCell into EnginePrefillReceipt. The foreground-preemption bypass and the calibration evidence guard now key on modelCalibration.requests. The submission branch now routes any request with a calibration cell, even without a native shutdown contract, through autoregressive.submitWithRetirement (about line 786). This relies on the calibration cell being internally minted. The new parameter is a bridge-internal API, not a coordinator-controlled field, as far as the supplied code shows. Admission gating through canSubmitWithNativeOwner and the shared-KV and service-allowance paths is unchanged. Prefix-cache scoping (T-041) is unchanged.

Coverage limit: the definition of modelCalibration, EngineMeasurementPurpose and submitWithRetirement, and the callers that supply measurementPurpose, were not supplied, so those are unreviewed.
